==Description==
The '''Fallen Hero''' was an enemy that appeared in the [[SFOTH Event]], where it could be considered the penultimate [[Enemies|enemy]] in [[The Heights]], as it spawned just before the [[Swordmaster]] spawned on the same wave. It was faster than the [[Slow Boss]] and had more health than it, which made it a very dangerous enemy. It could also be spawned by the [[Swordmaster]] itself.

==Appearance==
The '''Fallen Hero''' had a black {{RLinkC|64444871|Dominus Messor}} and skull shoulder-pads, similar to the first version of the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]]. It had red menacing eyes, white skin, and navy black torso, sleeves and legs.

==Strategy==
*Many [[Minigunner]]s and [[Ranger|Outlaw]]s are recommended for defeating the '''Fallen Hero'''.
**Support towers such as the [[Commander]] and [[Militant|John]] can aid with this.
*The [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' ability can stop this, giving you time to buy towers or upgrade them.
**Do note that the [[Freezer]]'s regular attack is unable to do so.
*The [[Pyromancer]] can be used to slow this down.

==Trivia==
*The '''Fallen Hero''' looked similar to the first version of the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Guardian|Guardian]] from ''Tower Battles''.
*The skull shoulder pads used by the '''Fallen Hero''' are the {{RLinkC|4765718|The Riddling Skull}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
